tagline: The Lunar Lander tournament that no one was asking for!
short_description: A Lunar Lander tournament site served at ll.seekdepth.net.
long_description: ll-seekdepth-net is a small GitHub Pages project hosting a Lunar Lander tournament, custom-bound to the domain ll.seekdepth.net via its CNAME file. The repository itself contains only a README and the CNAME; the live tournament page is served from the custom domain.
notes: Repo contains only README.md and CNAME (2 files, 1KB). Live probe returned 200 and redirected to custom domain http://ll.seekdepth.net/ (CNAME value ll.seekdepth.net); https URL used. No source code present in repo, so tech limited to Pages/Markdown/CNAME and tournament format details unknown.
